name: bb-plugin-session-import
description: bb plugin: import a Claude Code session from any machine bb reaches as a new bb thread, seeded with a cleaned transcript, with the original session readable beside it.

bb.name: Session Import
bb.description: Continue a Claude Code session started outside bb: pick it from any machine, and a new thread starts in its directory with the cleaned transcript. The original stays readable beside the thread.

//: better-sqlite3 is optional: only the server tests (bb's fake plugin host) need it, and bb-plugins-sync installs with --omit=optional, so no host builds it.
